title: check-governed-merges: git() drops stdin, so `--pr` and the post-merge audit read every moved path as explained (check-attr --stdin)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAm8Y73VGNq3PkTe3dc

Filing gate: ① defect with a named location and a reproduction · Source: fleet (found by area f2-C's dev while fixing #36537; os-dev-report 7137165935 on #36537)

## What happens

In `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, `git(root, args)` spawns git with stdin ignored, and that function is handed as `runGit` to the guard's readers by `--pr` (`pullRecordStage`) and by `readArmLanding`. `unexplainedPathsBetween` feeds the moved paths to `git check-attr --stdin`; with stdin dropped, check-attr reads nothing, so every moved path reads as explained and `regenCarry` can read a false carry.

## Reproduction (measured by the dev)

PR #36509's trees `4342cf009..bf71994326` (base `e4e3bcfe`): 14 unexplained paths when stdin is passed, 0 when stdin is ignored.

## Reach

The queue guard passes input itself, so the merge gate is not affected. Wrong today: the `--pr` reading a seat takes before landing, and the post-merge governed audit. A seat that trusts `--pr` on a regen PR can arm a landing the queue then refuses, and the audit under-reports.

## Expected

The `runGit` handed to these readers passes stdin through (or the readers that need stdin take their own spawner), with a self-test case that fails today: a moved path with a non-regen attribute reads as unexplained.

Surface: `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` (+ its self-test). Guard instrument ⇒ always Tier H.
Business reason: the seats' pre-landing reading and the governed audit are the maintainer's after-the-fact defence for governed merges; a reader that always says "explained" hides exactly the case it exists to show.
Reader who acts: seat `repo:objectstack#2`, area f2-C (lease extended to this file).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open check-governed-merges stdin` → 2 hits (#36537, the source card, whose fix is in label-write.mjs, not this file; #6015, the triage seat post); `is:issue is:open unexplainedPathsBetween` → 1 hit (#36537, the same).
Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none
Grade: area:fleet · Bug · wrong reading in a fleet guard's report paths, merge gate unaffected → p2.
